title: 🗒️ Images In Notes
summary: View what's new in Raycast v2.10
body_markdown:
[v2.10](https://www.raycast.com/changelog/macos/2-10) October 28, 2026


In this week's release, we've made a bunch of updates to Raycast Notes, some of which have been highly requested!


Your notes can now support images, including gifs! Drag and drop them onto your notes, click and drag to re-order them, and even reference external image sources in markdown. They all display the way you'd expect them to. We’ve also added the ability to re-order list items via drag and drop, we’ve brought back the auto-size button that appears below your note, and on Golden Gate, you can now hide your Notes window while screen sharing again!


And while we're here, we've also decided to lift the 5 note limit on the free plan. This means that everyone can now create as many notes as needed.


## ✨ New


- **AI Chat** : Added support for searching and mentioning items from compatible AI Extensions directly from the` @` menu, bringing their content into the conversation
- **Contacts** : Added actions to edit and delete contacts
- **Notes:** You can now add images to notes
- **Notes:** Free plan now gets unlimited notes


## 💎 Improvements


- **AI Chat** : Table headers now stay visible while scrolling through long tables
- **AI Chat** : Improved attachment layout and keyboard tab order in composer
- **AI Chat** : Improved` cmd+P` search and show chat statuses while browsing
- **AI Chat** : Long chats now open, scroll, and stream replies faster while using less memory
- **AI** : Usage meters now warn in orange and red as you approach the limit
- **Dictation:** Post-processing improvements to reduce unwanted em dashes and unexpected whitespace
- **My Schedule:** Added missing *Copy Event Attendee* actions
- **Notes:** You can now drag and drop list items
- **Notes** : Clicking a checkbox while holding` ⌘` will also complete its children
- **Notes** : Hide while screen recording is back on Golden Gate only (macOS 27+) - this will hide your notes window when you’re sharing screen in for example Zoom
- **Search** : Improved performance of translation queries


## 🐞 Fixes


- **Action Panel** : Fixed searching extension actions by their keywords or section title
- **AI:** Added the same reasoning effort shortcut to model preference
- **AI Chat** : Fixed multiple sign-in windows opening when using several tools from the same extension
- **Emoji Picker** : Fixed an issue where the empty state would show whilst loading AI suggestions
- **Extensions** : Fixed typing freezes when filtering lists that contain items with very long text
- **Import:** Fixed an issue where unknown icons imported from v1 could mismatch and show no icon
- **MCP** : Fixed connection timeouts with servers that use streaming HTTP responses
- **Quicklinks** : Fixed copying a personal Quicklink not updating its usage count
- **Snippets & Quicklinks** : Fixed stale dynamic placeholder values when copying Quicklinks or copying and pasting snippets
- **UI** : Fixed a regression preventing compact mode users from seeing toasts
- **Window Layouts:** Fixed a regression where layouts would be applied incorrectly to displays arranged vertically
